voice-button.autoReady: Speak — I’ll answer after a pause

settings.title: Settings
settings.qr-scanner-hint: Point the camera at the QR code
settings.device-id-hint: Each device has a unique ID used to link devices together. Use "Show QR Code" so another device can scan it, or use "Identify" to scan another device's QR code. This allows multiple devices to sync and will be used for server authentication.

speech-test.title: Speech recognition
speech-test.hint: Tap the microphone button and start speaking — words will appear one after another.
speech-test.status-recording: Recording. Press Stop to recognize your speech.
speech-test.status-no-speech: No speech detected. Try recording your phrase again.
speech-test.hint-gigaam: Tap the microphone, wait for recording to start, and say a phrase. Then press Stop — GigaAM will transcribe the recording.

gigaam.description: Download the speech model for your selected language once to use it offline.
gigaam.ready: Model downloaded and ready to use offline.

supertonic.description: Offline speech in Russian and English. Shared download: about 401 MB, 10 voices. Download starts only with the button. Once ready, close this window and press Listen.
supertonic.failed: Download failed. Check your connection and free storage, then retry.
supertonic.synthesis-failed: Speech synthesis failed. Try again or select the system voice.
